_comment: One policy for every host. Regexes must work in both Python and JavaScript. deny blocks, ask requires the user to approve. Every rule has a unique name and the guard prints it as (rule: <name>), so a blocked agent can find the rule here, and every reason says the way forward. Commands are checked after normalize() removes line continuations, commit messages and cat/tee heredoc bodies; a code mode script also loses the string values of data keys (content, oldText and the like), so a doc that quotes a blocked command can still be written. Codex and OpenCode also get native ask rules (see adapters). After editing, run guard/check.sh.

deny.name: rm-root-home
deny.reason: Recursive delete of root or home is blocked. Delete one named path, or ask the user.

deny.name: find-root-delete
deny.reason: Deleting with find from root or home is blocked. Target one directory, or ask the user.

deny.name: force-push
deny.reason: Force push is blocked. Use --force-with-lease, push normally, or ask the user.

deny.name: reset-hard
deny.reason: git reset --hard is blocked. Use git stash instead.

deny.name: git-clean-force
deny.reason: git clean -f is blocked. List files with git clean -n and ask the user.

deny.name: mkfs
deny.reason: Formatting disks is blocked. Pick the filesystem path with the user.

deny.name: diskutil-erase
deny.reason: Erasing disks is blocked. Pick the disk with the user.

deny.name: dd-raw-device
deny.reason: Writing to raw devices is blocked. Pick the device with the user.

deny.name: download-to-shell
deny.reason: Piping a download into a shell is blocked. Download, read, then run.

deny.name: download-to-interpreter
deny.reason: Piping a download into an interpreter is blocked. Download, read, then run.

deny.name: run-download
deny.reason: Running a download directly is blocked. Download, read, then run.

deny.name: ssh-write-redirect
deny.reason: Writing inside ~/.ssh is blocked. Write the file elsewhere, then ask the user to move it.

deny.name: ssh-write-move
deny.reason: Writing inside ~/.ssh is blocked. Write the file elsewhere, then ask the user to move it.

deny.name: chmod-777
deny.reason: chmod -R 777 is blocked. Use a narrower mode, or ask the user.

deny.name: git-checkout-force
deny.reason: Forced checkout or switch discards uncommitted changes. Stash or commit first, or ask the user.

deny.name: git-discard-all
deny.reason: Wholesale discard of local changes is blocked. Target specific paths (e.g. git checkout -- src/file), or ask the user.

deny.name: git-stash-drop
deny.reason: git stash drop and clear destroy stashed work. List stashes with git stash list, or ask the user.

deny.name: git-worktree-remove-force
deny.reason: Forced worktree removal discards uncommitted work in that tree. Use git worktree remove without -f, or ask the user.

deny.name: git-reflog-expire
deny.reason: Expiring the reflog removes recovery paths for lost commits. Ask the user before expiring reflogs.

deny.name: git-branch-force-delete
deny.reason: Force deleting a branch discards unmerged commits. Use git branch -d instead, or ask the user.

deny.name: git-update-ref-delete
deny.reason: git update-ref -d deletes a ref directly. Use git branch -d for branches, or ask the user.

deny.name: git-filter-branch
deny.reason: git filter-branch rewrites history across every branch. Use a targeted branch operation, or ask the user.

deny.name: git-no-verify
deny.reason: Bypassing git hooks with --no-verify is blocked. Fix the hook failure, or ask the user.

deny.name: git-hooks-bypass
deny.reason: Bypassing git hooks via core.hooksPath or LIMINAL_SKIP_HOOKS is blocked. Fix the hook failure, or ask the user.

deny.name: rm-harness-or-code
deny.reason: Recursive delete of harness config, code workspace, or cwd/parent is blocked. Target one explicit subdirectory, or ask the user.

ask.name: milestone-run
ask.reason: A milestone run commits, so it needs explicit user approval.

ask.name: gh-publish
ask.reason: Publishing to GitHub needs explicit user approval.

ask.name: npm-publish
ask.reason: Publishing packages needs explicit user approval.

ask.name: docker-push
ask.reason: Pushing images needs explicit user approval.

ask.name: terraform-apply
ask.reason: Infrastructure changes need explicit user approval.

ask.name: kubectl-change
ask.reason: Cluster changes need explicit user approval.

ask.name: publish-package
ask.reason: Publishing packages needs explicit user approval.

ask.name: gh-write
ask.reason: Posting or changing things on GitHub speaks as the user, so it needs explicit approval.

ask.name: send-mail
ask.reason: Sending mail needs explicit user approval.

ask.name: guard-shell-write
ask.reason: Changing the guard from the shell needs explicit user approval.

tools._comment: Matched against the lowercased tool name (MCP tools included), so connected apps get the same deny and ask gate as the shell.

ask.name: mcp-delete
ask.reason: Deleting data in a connected app needs explicit user approval.

ask.name: mcp-send
ask.reason: Sending, publishing or cancelling in a connected app speaks as the user, so it needs explicit approval.

ask.name: mcp-money
ask.reason: Purchases and money movement need explicit user approval.

ask.name: mcp-account
ask.reason: Account changes need explicit user approval.

deny_write.name: ssh-path
deny_write.reason: Writing inside ~/.ssh is blocked. Ask the user to change that file.

deny_write.name: ssh-key
deny_write.reason: Writing SSH keys is blocked. Ask the user, or run ssh-keygen with the user present.

deny_write.name: key-cert
deny_write.reason: Writing key or certificate files is blocked. Generate them with the tool that owns them.

deny_write.name: key-file
deny_write.reason: Writing key files is blocked. Generate them with the tool that owns them.

ask_write.name: env-file
ask_write.reason: Editing .env files needs explicit user approval.

ask_write.name: guard-edit
ask_write.reason: Editing the guard itself needs explicit user approval.
